tasks.short: Prepare news releases and answer police correspondence

steps.what: Establish the correspondence purpose, verified facts and permitted disclosure boundaries
Draft the news release or correspondence response from the checked communication brief

loop.purpose: Draft plain correspondence or a release from permitted facts
loop.input: Checked facts, disclosure boundaries, audience and approved response format
loop.output: Draft communication with each factual statement linked to its brief source
loop.check: Supervisor checks factual meaning, uncertainty, unanswered questions and whether wording exposes restricted or identifying information
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved disclosure or unsupported claims return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle fixed notices first; variable questions and narrative wording require semantic drafting

steps.what: Review disclosure and accuracy, approve the exact message and issue the communication

tasks.design: Use approved {DOCS} templates first, with a bounded {WORKFLOW} draft for variable releases and replies. The supervisor establishes permitted facts and checks the exact final message and recipients before issuing through {EMAIL} or {CMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Variable correspondence requires repeated prose writing around carefully checked facts.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting can prepare wording while preserving a source trail.
tasks.still_hard: Disclosure, reputational harm and wording that implies more certainty than the evidence supports.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable communication and sensitivity to affected people.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft writing; communication and disclosure authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check a sensitive release and publication route

evidence.claim: Template-first, source-constrained correspondence drafting is an E1 design assumption; no digest case establishes this task's saving.
An Anchorage police report drafting trial found no real time-saving advantage after review, illustrating why draft time alone is not a labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor preparation and issuance within existing authority; original investigation and separate specialist approval are excluded and not accelerated.
Supervisor produces audience, purpose, fact sources, permitted disclosures and response deadline in fully retained s1. Unknown facts remain explicitly unknown rather than being inferred.

S2's 17.5 retained hours include semantic draft checks; s3's forty hours retain final disclosure review, recipient verification and release. If another approver is mandatory, include that person's unchanged labour before rollout.
Try native response templates before a model. Three incremental supervisor hours per 100 baseline hours cover template freshness, access and sampled draft quality.
unknowns: Disclosure authority, release volume and review requirements
research_questions: Do routine replies save net time after all factual and disclosure checks?

already_counted.description: Semantic draft checks and writing exceptions
Final disclosure review, exact approval and issuance

approvals.approved_version: Exact final message text, attachments, recipients, channel and publication time; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R82.5; gross17.5 less3 upkeep gives14.5 net. Sensitive cases can need complete rewriting and yield minus3; brief creation and final disclosure checks retain65.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare departmental budgets and manage expenditures

steps.what: Gather departmental actuals, commitments and operational assumptions for the budget
Prepare departmental budget scenarios from checked cost and activity assumptions
Choose spending priorities and approve the departmental budget proposal within authority
Review spending against budget and decide corrective action on expenditure exceptions

tasks.design: Configure departmental budget models in {ERP}, with native actual-versus-budget views before adding {BI}. Reuse verified transactions for arithmetic while the supervisor captures operational assumptions, chooses priorities and decides expenditure actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget preparation repeats extraction, arithmetic and variance comparisons.
tasks.enabler_now: Native budget models and commitment reports support deterministic scenario calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing priorities under uncertainty and interpreting exceptional spending.
tasks.human_edge: Balancing operational readiness with available funds.

ambition.what: Review committed as well as posted spending before the next departmental allocation decision

tasks.altitude: Less report assembly and arithmetic; budget authority remains unchanged.

reach.task: Reconcile commitments and validate budget scenarios

evidence.claim: Native financial budget models and commitment reporting support deterministic scenario preparation; this task's saving is an E1 assumption.

assumptions: Boundary includes supervisor budget preparation and expenditure review, excluding finance posting, organisation-wide approval and payment execution.

Existing finance staff produce transaction amount, date, cost centre, account and commitment balance in their unchanged ledger workflow. Supervisor captures forecast period, activity volumes, unit costs and exceptional assumptions in s1's fifteen retained hours; missing or inconsistent values are resolved manually there.

S2's twelve retained hours include formula checks, scenario input and reconciliation. S4's twelve retained hours include interpretation and corrective decisions; arithmetic comparisons alone are configured.
Test native budget functions first. Four incremental supervisor hours per 100 baseline hours cover model, mapping and exception-threshold maintenance.
unknowns: Current financial system, commitment quality and budget authority
research_questions: Do native reports reduce preparation after assumption capture and reconciliation?

incremental.description: Budget model, mappings and threshold upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R64; gross36 less4 upkeep gives32 net. Poor commitment data may leave only10 hours of arithmetic and retrieval gain, giving6 net; spending priorities retain25.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce routine drafting and budget arithmetic while retaining disclosure, priorities and spending judgement.
reach: Review sensitive releases with communications advice
Reconcile financial models with a finance analyst
role.ambitious_version: Clearer correspondence and earlier visibility of departmental commitments, with decisions remaining accountable.
